name: Sarah M.
text: Finally someone mentioned using a hydrating primer first! I was always doing matte primers and wondered why my shadows still creased. This totally changed my routine.

name: Jessica T.
text: Does anyone else's eyeshadow still crease even with primer? Maybe it's just my oily lids but I feel like nothing works for me.

name: Marcus K.
text: The setting spray tip at the end was game-changing. I never thought about spraying before AND after eyeshadow application. Trying this tomorrow!

name: Elena P.
text: Great guide but I wish you mentioned the Urban Decay Primer Potion specifically - that's what actually works for my combo skin. Everyone's different I guess.

name: David L.
text: My girlfriend showed me this and I finally understand why her makeup lasts all day. Honestly impressed by how technical makeup application actually is.
